scope_items.item: respx tests confirm each Stats tool calls the documented path on stats_url with the Authorization: <access key>:<secret key> header, and that parameters passed as None are omitted
Paginated Stats responses expose page and next-page fields in the tool result
When keys are missing (has_keys false), every Stats tool returns the clear missing-credentials ToolRefused and makes no request
Scenario S1 output can be assembled: bucket_list plus stats_bucket_utilization_list give per-bucket stored bytes in the unit test
scope_items.evidence: tests/tools/test_stats.py:363-394 (stand-in bucket_list names, per spec Q1)

scope_items.item: New module tools/stats.py with register(server, ctx), four READ tools
stats_account_utilization_list: GET /v1/standalone/utilizations with date range, latest, include_regional, page params and *_human sizes
stats_bucket_utilization_list: GET /v1/standalone/utilizations/bucket; RecordCount/PageCount carried forward from page 0
stats_bucket_utilization_get: by bucket name or bucket number (exactly one)
stats_usage_summary: latest-day totals and top top_n buckets by active storage
Pagination fields items, page_num, page_size, next_page_num, page_count, record_count, truncated
Input validation before any request (dates, range order, page bounds, bucket args, top_n)
401/403 re-raised as ToolRefused explaining root / WasabiAccountStatsAccess / WasabiBucketStatsAccess

edge_cases.description: Bucket names with reserved characters are URL-quoted (safe='') so they cannot alter the request path
Impossible dates (2026-02-30) and non-ISO formats refused
Bare-list responses without RecordCount/PageCount fall back to full-page heuristic
Summary bucket paging capped at 10 pages with truncated flag
Records missing PaddedStorageSizeBytes sort as 0 in top buckets
Boolean values are excluded from *Bytes numeric detection and _human siblings
Negative bucket_number is not validated before the request (Wasabi would reject it)
